name: XDKNet 2.5.17
body:
Android TV 2.5.17, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.16 (Emby 2.0.5.16).
Update the plugin too: the Calendar fix is in the plugin. Without it the
Upcoming rows and the Calendar stay empty where they were empty before; this
TV release only explains why.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This release is for everyone. Fixing what the Calendar reports may need the
server's admin.

## Calendar and Upcoming rows

- The Upcoming rows and the Calendar now read Radarr and Sonarr from the
  servers set up in the XDKNet plugin settings, at the address set there and
  with Seerr's API key when one is saved. Before, they used only the address
  Seerr keeps and an admin's Seerr sign-in, so a Radarr that Seerr knows by a
  Docker name, or a sign-in that had expired, left them empty with no word
  of why.
- When the Calendar can't load, it now says why. An admin is told what to
  fix, for example that a host name doesn't resolve from the server or that
  no Seerr admin has signed in, and the plugin log keeps it too. Everyone else
  is told the server couldn't read it.
- Include unmonitored, in Calendar Settings, now brings in what Radarr and
  Sonarr aren't monitoring.

## For the server's admin

- If the Calendar says the server can't reach Radarr or Sonarr, open
  Dashboard > Plugins > XDKNet > Radarr and Sonarr, see which server doesn't
  answer, and enter the address the Jellyfin server should use for it.
- Save Seerr's API key (in Seerr under Settings > General) in the plugin
  settings, so the calendar doesn't depend on an admin's Seerr sign-in, which
  expires.
- On Emby the calendar works as it did.
